summary: Backend pytest suite (25 tests) all PASS. Frontend UI tests uncovered ONE CRITICAL React crash: `ReferenceError: isOwner is not defined` inside pages/Projects.jsx (parent Projects component used `isOwner` inside InstructionBanner but only defined it inside child ProjectCard). This blank-screened both Owner /projects and Employee /projects (Employee lands on /projects, so employee login was fully broken). Testing agent applied the minimal fix (added const { role } = useAuth(); const isOwner = ... in Projects parent) and re-verified — Owner + Employee /projects now render cleanly, no console/page errors. All other role/route/redirect/calculator/nav assertions pass.

ui_bugs.component: pages/Projects.jsx (Projects parent component, line 148 before fix)
ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught ReferenceError: isOwner is not defined — blank-screened /projects for BOTH owner and employee. isOwner was defined only inside the ProjectCard sub-component but referenced in the parent Projects InstructionBanner ternary. Fix: add `const { role } = useAuth(); const isOwner = (role || 'owner') === 'owner';` in the Projects parent. FIXED by testing agent — verified: owner /projects renders margin-aware banner, employee /projects renders addresses/crew banner with no money leaks.

action_items: Review testing-agent's fix to /app/frontend/src/pages/Projects.jsx (added useAuth hook + isOwner constant in the Projects parent component). Kept behavior identical to what the InstructionBanner already assumed.
critical_code_review_comments: pages/Projects.jsx had scope leak: isOwner used in parent but defined in child — indicates a duplicate/refactor miss. The InstructionBanner ternary in the parent needs the same auth context the ProjectCard uses. Recommend hoisting isOwner (or the whole useAuth call) to a shared parent or using a small useIsOwner() hook to avoid this class of bug elsewhere.

Frontend bundle hygiene verified: no `driverHr`/`helperHr` in /app/frontend/src; only reference to `crew_cost` is inside an `{isOwner && internal && ...}` gated block (Projects.jsx line 113-128) that only renders for owner tokens and only when backend sends `internal` (owner-only field).
Existing test file /app/backend/tests/test_auth.py already covered auth+roles thoroughly (25 tests, all pass). No changes needed.

Only fix applied: added useAuth hook to Projects parent to resolve `isOwner is not defined` runtime error.
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/frontend/src/pages/Projects.jsx defines two components — inner ProjectCard (line 30) which correctly calls useAuth() and computes `isOwner`, and outer Projects (line 135) which uses `{isOwner ? ... : ...}` inside InstructionBanner (line 148) without importing or computing `isOwner` in that scope. JavaScript hoisting cannot help since `isOwner` is a `const` local to ProjectCard. REPRODUCTION: log in as any role → navigate to /projects → page throws ReferenceError, React error overlay shown (dev build) → blank page in prod. MITIGATION APPLIED: added `const { role } = useAuth(); const isOwner = (role || 'owner') === 'owner';` at the top of the Projects component body. Verified via browser automation: no console/page errors, projects-page test-id renders, correct role-specific banner text ('margin' for owner vs 'addresses, crew, and truck' for employee).
